text:
kai: Proposal: add a lightweight lane-selector that assigns requests to FP8/INT8/4bit lanes before runtime. keep runtime dumb: it only sees quant_profile_id.

meera: why upstream? to avoid per-request handshakes in hot path?

kai: exactly. selector uses simple features (token_count, kv_hit, endpoint_sensitivity) and returns lane id + profile.

oz: how do we detect quality regressions quickly? degscore is noisy at low traffic.

meera: sample 1% of lane traffic as shadow against FP32 baseline, compute embedding drift + hallucination flag. if drift>threshold or hallucination spikes, pause promotions.

tara: cache problems: must namespace KV/attn caches by profile id. otherwise long sessions break. sessions should carry precision_affinity.

ci-bot: staging-canary: 5000 reqs, fp8=12%, int8=28%, 4bit=6%. fp8 drift median=0.02, int8=0.03, 4bit=0.058 -> 4bit flagged.

oz: 4bit above 0.05 baseline. options: raise threshold for prob tasks or mark 4bit for small-prompt-only.

kai: add task_sensitivity tag on endpoints. default thresholds: prob-tasks 0.06, precise-tasks 0.04. also require sustained failure (>=1% failure over 10m) before rollback.

meera: billing question: who pays for shadow eval tokens? platform covers base budget; tenants can opt-in to larger evals. surface in console.

tara: operationally we need quick toggles. selector config with TTL=5s and per-tenant enable/disable switch. UI + API required.

oz: schema sketch (keep simple): tenant, static_tier, adaptive_rules, pinned_sessions_allowed, fallbacks, shadow_token_quota, schema_v.

kai: next: RFC addendum with schema_v, prototype selector service, replay tests for top-15 tenants. opening PR and a work ticket. tagging @platform and @console. :sparkles:
